name: Leaf
source:
A plant fairy who possesses Alice. She is a good friend of Alice, and often consults and hangs out with her. She dotes on Alice.

[Translated from [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/midorino_himegimi.html#chara]official website[/url]]
